visual.name: atlasProportion
visual.description: Mekko, waffle, pictogram, aster plot, rose (polar area) and Venn diagram in one visual, with flat, soft and 3D looks and a palette that follows your report theme, a brand color or your own colors.

en-US.Role_Category_Desc: Columns of a Mekko, wedges of a rose or aster, waffle parts, icon rows, or Venn regions written as "A & B".
en-US.Role_Series_Desc: Optional. Segments of a Mekko column or stacked rose wedge.
en-US.Role_Values_Desc: The value. A second measure is the total (waffle, pictogram) or the weight (aster).
en-US.Landing_Line1: Add a field to Category and a measure to Values. Add a Legend for Mekko segments or a stacked rose.
en-US.Landing_Line2: A second measure is the total (waffle, pictogram) or the weight (aster). For a Venn diagram, write overlaps in Category as "A & B".
en-US.Venn_Sets: A Venn diagram needs 2 or 3 sets. Write overlaps in Category as "A & B".
en-US.Warn_Limit_Text: There is more data than the visual can show. Filter the report to see the rest.
en-US.Mark_Selected: Selected: this visual is filtering other visuals
en-US.Mark_Filter: This visual is filtering the report
en-US.Mark_Highlighted: Highlighted by a selection in another visual
